author: TheTrojan303
quote:
Was very hyped for this game, but 20 hours in and its just doing boring chores for Lucia and dealing with 'babied' mechanics that restrict real GTA gameplay. The last straw is having to deal with these stupid flashback sequences having to feed and take care of a baby, like who asked for this? What sort of feminist mob has taken over Rockstar. Where are the badass characters like CJ, Nico or Trevor that were so beloved to play as. This is such a disappointment after experiencing the masterpiece that was RDR2 from Rockstar. This is just terrible and I have gotten a refund. This is not a 'video game', its a feminist simulator to punish us for paying $120 to do stupid chores that are focused on 'girl power'. 

All the critics giving this game a 9+ are literal shills, There have been insane video games released this year that truly were works of art and not feminist slop.
